• Verify that the Interface Version (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00053]) matches

• Verify that the Return Code (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00058] and [PRS_SOMEIP_

(0x00).
If any of the above checks fails the received SOME/IP request mes-
sage shall be discarded. In case of a received REQUEST mes-
sage (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00055]), additionally, an ERROR mes-
sage with return code set to either
E_WRONG_PROTOCOL_VERSION
,
E_UNKNOWN_SERVICE
,
E_WRONG_INTERFACE_VERSION
,
E_UNKNOWN_METHOD
,
or
E_WRONG_MESSAGE_TYPE
(see [PRS_SOMEIP_00191]) shall be sent to the
requester, depending on the detected error.
